mapper.select: SELECT trip_id, member_id, title, start_date, end_date FROM trips WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT report_id, trip_id, generation_status, locale FROM reports WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY report_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ti.trip_item_id, ti.item_id, ti.visit_date, ei.item_type, COALESCE(e.title, p.name) AS title, ti.trip_item_status AS status FROM trip_items ti JOIN explore_items ei ON ei.item_id = ti.item_id AND ei.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN event e ON e.event_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN place p ON p.place_id = ei.item_id AND ei.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ti.trip_id = #{tripId} AND ti.deleted_at IS NULL AND ( (ei.item_type = 'EVENT' AND e.event_id IS NOT NULL) OR (ei.item_type = 'PLACE' AND p.place_id IS NOT NULL) ) ORDER BY ti.visit_date ASC, ti.display_order ASC, ti.trip_item_id ASC
mapper.sql: t.transfer_id, le.ledger_entry_id, le.amount, DATE(t.completed_at) AS occurred_on, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.spending_category, ''), 'OTHER') AS category, t.memo
mapper.select: SELECT , CASE WHEN tel.trip_id = #{tripId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS selected FROM wallet_ledger_entries le JOIN wallet_transfers t ON t.transfer_id = le.transfer_id JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = le.wallet_id AND w.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN wallet_owners wo ON wo.wallet_owner_id = w.wallet_owner_id AND wo.member_id = #{memberId} AND wo.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN trips tr ON tr.trip_id = #{tripId} AND tr.member_id = #{memberId} AND tr.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN trip_expense_links tel ON tel.ledger_entry_id = le.ledger_entry_id AND tel.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE le.entry_type = 'DEBIT' AND le.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.initiator_member_id = #{memberId} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.currency_code = 'KRW' AND t.transfer_status = 'COMPLETED' AND t.transfer_type IN ('QR_PAYMENT', 'SETTLEMENT') AND DATE(t.completed_at) BETWEEN tr.start_date AND tr.end_date AND (tel.trip_id IS NULL OR tel.trip_id = #{tripId}) ORDER BY t.completed_at ASC, t.transfer_id ASC
SELECT ledger_entry_id FROM trip_expense_links WHERE trip_id = #{tripId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY ledger_entry_id ASC
SELECT trip_id FROM trip_expense_links WHERE ledger_entry_id = #{ledgerEntryId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports (trip_id, generation_status, locale, report_content, generated_at) VALUES (#{tripId}, #{generationStatus}, #{locale}, #{reportContent, typeHandler=me.nawa.explore.mapper.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id, r.trip_id, t.member_id, t.title, t.start_date, t.end_date, r.generation_status, r.locale, r.report_content, r.generated_at, r.created_at FROM reports r JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = r.trip_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT r.report_id, r.trip_id, t.member_id, t.title, t.start_date, t.end_date, r.generation_status, r.locale, r.generated_at, r.created_at FROM reports r JOIN trips t ON t.trip_id = r.trip_id AND t.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE t.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.report_id DESC
